description: The figure contains two side-by-side pie charts titled “All Changes” and “All Errors,” each showing the distribution of outcomes across six labeled categories (P, PW, R, RW, N, NW) as indicated by the shared legend on the right. In “All Changes,” the slices are P in light green at about 50%, PW in darker green at about 4%, R in very light yellow at about 26%, RW in darker golden/yellow at about 14%, N in light blue at about 1%, and NW in dark blue at about 5%. In “All Errors,” the slices are P (light green) at about 56%, PW (darker green) at about 3%, R (very light yellow) at about 29%, RW (darker golden/yellow) at about 6%, N (light blue) at about 1%, and NW (dark blue) at about 5%. Both charts display percentage labels outside the slices with leader lines, and several wedges (notably the smaller PW, RW, and the blue slices) appear slightly separated/offset from the main circle; no single slice is highlighted with a distinct annotation beyond this exploded styling, and the slices are arranged around the circle without an explicitly stated ordering rule.
